name: login-05
title: Login 05
description: Email first, on a plain sheet of paper that is the whole page: Stubby waves, one field emails a sign-in link, Apple and Google below. After the link is sent the form says so and lets you fix the address. Brings its own paper, so it reads the same on the desk or on paper.
docs:
Installed the "Login 05" block into your components directory under blocks/login-05/.
Import it: import Login05Page from "<your components alias>/blocks/login-05/page"
Needs vee-validate@^5, vee-validate@^7, zod@^4: the CLI installs them (a project on an older major is upgraded).
